namespace Pipeline.Generated

/-- Drop lines equal to `prev` until a different line appears; that different
    line is kept and becomes the new comparison point. -/
def collapse (prev : String) : List String → List String
  | [] => []
  | y :: ys => if y = prev then collapse prev ys else y :: collapse y ys

/-- Keep exactly the first copy of each maximal run of adjacent identical
    lines. Non-adjacent repeats are all kept. -/
def uniq : List String → List String
  | [] => []
  | x :: xs => x :: collapse x xs

/-- uniq: read stdin, write one copy of each run of adjacent duplicate lines,
    exit 0. Options and file operands are out of modeled scope. -/
def run (args stdin : List String) : List String × UInt32 :=
  (uniq stdin, 0)

/-- No two adjacent elements of the list are equal. -/
def noAdjDup : List String → Prop
  | [] => True
  | [_] => True
  | x :: y :: rest => x ≠ y ∧ noAdjDup (y :: rest)

theorem collapse_subset (a prev : String) (xs : List String) :
    a ∈ collapse prev xs → a ∈ xs := by
  induction xs generalizing prev with
  | nil => simp [collapse]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    by_cases h : y = prev
    · simp only [collapse, if_pos h]
      intro ha
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem y (ih prev ha)
    · simp only [collapse, if_neg h, List.mem_cons]
      intro ha
      cases ha with
      | inl hy => exact Or.inl hy
      | inr hr => exact Or.inr (ih y hr)

theorem collapse_length (prev : String) (xs : List String) :
    (collapse prev xs).length ≤ xs.length := by
  induction xs generalizing prev with
  | nil => simp [collapse]
  | cons y ys ih =>
    by_cases h : y = prev
    · simp only [collapse, if_pos h]
      exact Nat.le_trans (ih prev) (Nat.le_succ ys.length)
    · simp only [collapse, if_neg h, List.length_cons]
      exact Nat.succ_le_succ (ih y)

theorem collapse_collapse (prev : String) (xs : List String) :
    collapse prev (collapse prev xs) = collapse prev xs := by
  induction xs generalizing prev with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons y ys ih =>
    by_cases h : y = prev
    · simp only [collapse, if_pos h]
      exact ih prev
    · simp only [collapse, if_neg h]
      rw [ih y]

theorem noAdjDup_cons_collapse (prev : String) (xs : List String) :
    noAdjDup (prev :: collapse prev xs) := by
  induction xs generalizing prev with
  | nil => exact True.intro
  | cons y ys ih =>
    by_cases h : y = prev
    · simp only [collapse, if_pos h]
      exact ih prev
    · simp only [collapse, if_neg h]
      exact ⟨fun he => h he.symm, ih y⟩

/-- Exit status: successful completion is reported as 0 for every input. -/
theorem run_exit_success (args stdin : List String) :
    (run args stdin).2 = 0 := rfl

/-- Content preservation: every output line is a line of the input
    (uniq only writes copies of input lines). -/
theorem run_output_membership (args stdin : List String) (a : String) :
    a ∈ (run args stdin).1 → a ∈ stdin := by
  cases stdin with
  | nil => simp [run, uniq]
  | cons x xs =>
    simp only [run, uniq, List.mem_cons]
    intro h
    cases h with
    | inl hx => exact Or.inl hx
    | inr hr => exact Or.inr (collapse_subset a x xs hr)

/-- Length bound: suppressing repeated copies never produces more output
    lines than input lines. -/
theorem run_output_length_le (args stdin : List String) :
    (run args stdin).1.length ≤ stdin.length := by
  cases stdin with
  | nil => exact Nat.le_refl 0
  | cons x xs =>
    exact Nat.succ_le_succ (collapse_length x xs)

/-- Core correctness: the output contains no adjacent duplicate lines
    (second and succeeding copies of adjacent repeats are not written). -/
theorem run_no_adjacent_duplicates (args stdin : List String) :
    noAdjDup (run args stdin).1 := by
  cases stdin with
  | nil => exact True.intro
  | cons x xs => exact noAdjDup_cons_collapse x xs

/-- Idempotence: the output is already free of adjacent repeats, so running
    uniq on its own output changes nothing. -/
theorem run_idempotent (args stdin : List String) :
    (run args (run args stdin).1).1 = (run args stdin).1 := by
  cases stdin with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs =>
    show uniq (x :: collapse x xs) = x :: collapse x xs
    simp only [uniq]
    rw [collapse_collapse]

/-- First line preserved: the first input line is always written first
    (one copy of each line is written, in order). -/
theorem run_head_preserved (args stdin : List String) :
    (run args stdin).1.head? = stdin.head? := by
  cases stdin with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs => rfl

end Pipeline.Generated

spec_theorems.name: run_exit_success
spec_theorems.informal: uniq exits with status 0 (successful completion) for every argv and stdin.

spec_theorems.name: run_output_membership
spec_theorems.informal: Every output line is a copy of some input line (uniq writes one copy of each input line, never new text).

spec_theorems.name: run_output_length_le
spec_theorems.informal: Suppressing second and succeeding copies of repeated adjacent lines never yields more output lines than input lines.

spec_theorems.name: run_no_adjacent_duplicates
spec_theorems.informal: The output contains no two adjacent equal lines, since second and succeeding copies of repeated adjacent input lines are not written.

spec_theorems.name: run_idempotent
spec_theorems.informal: Running uniq on its own output changes nothing, because that output is already free of adjacent repeats.

spec_theorems.name: run_head_preserved
spec_theorems.informal: The first input line is always written as the first output line (the first copy of each run is kept, in input order).
